'''Bob Schultz''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 Ithaca tournament]] on 27 January 2001 with [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|SYCFA TIE Defenders]], according to Doug Faust's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1674">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-ithaca-ny-27-jan-01d1674/ ithaca-ny-27-jan-01], DeckTech (Doug "Phrim" Faust, 27 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-27-ithaca-ny-27-jan-01d1674/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
